title: Smiling Toddler Boy in Tall Grass Field, 1930s Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A charming full-length vintage snapshot depicting a young toddler boy standing and smiling in a grassy meadow. In the background, a body of water rests at the foot of a dense, sunlit hillside covered in trees and underbrush. The boy is dressed in a warm collared sweater and trousers typical of the Depression-era 1930s.
